title.zh: 破产、重组与解散（第 5A 与 10A 部分指定期限的进一步延长）命令 2024
title.en: Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution (Further Extension of Prescribed Periods for Parts 5A and 10A) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution (Further Extension of Prescribed Periods for Parts 5A and 10A) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 29 January 2024.

heading.en: Further extension of prescribed period for Part 5A of Act

text.en: 2. The prescribed period for the purposes of Part 5A of the Act is further extended for 24 months starting on 29 January 2024.

heading.en: Further extension of prescribed period for Part 10A of Act

text.en: 3. The prescribed period for the purposes of Part 10A of the Act is further extended for 24 months starting on 29 January 2024.
